# Twinkl Educational Publishing

> > Twinkl is a leading educational publisher specializing in decodable reading books, phonics resources, and early literacy materials for young learners.

Twinkl Educational Publishing offers a comprehensive range of educational resources including the Rhino Readers decodable book series, phonics programs aligned with DfE Letters and Sounds, and structured reading materials for early childhood education. Their products are designed to support children's literacy development through systematic phonics instruction and engaging, leveled reading books.
